title: Romans Bible Quiz - Chapter 14
description: Ten questions on Romans 14: accepting the weak in faith, food and days, the judgment seat of Christ, and not making a brother stumble.

questions.text: Whom does the chapter begin by telling them to accept?
questions.explanation: Romans 14:1 says to accept one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes over opinions.

answers.text: One who is weak in faith
One who is rich in this world
One who comes from far away

questions.text: What does the one who is weak eat, according to the text?
questions.explanation: Romans 14:2 says one man has faith to eat all things, but he who is weak eats only vegetables.

questions.text: To whom does another's servant stand or fall?
questions.explanation: Romans 14:4 asks who you are to judge another's servant, saying that to his own lord he stands or falls, and that he will be made to stand.

answers.text: To the one who judges him
To the rulers of the city

questions.text: What should each man do about esteeming one day above another?
questions.explanation: Romans 14:5 says one man esteems one day as more important and another esteems every day alike, and that each man should be fully assured in his own mind.

answers.text: Follow the custom of the city
Do as the one who is strong in faith does
Be fully assured in his own mind

questions.text: Whose are we, whether we live or die?
questions.explanation: Romans 14:8 says that if we live, we live to the Lord, and if we die, we die to the Lord, so whether we live or die we are the Lord's.

questions.text: Before what will all of them stand?
questions.explanation: Romans 14:10 asks why they judge or despise their brother, since we will all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.

questions.text: According to the quotation, what will every tongue do?
questions.explanation: Romans 14:11 quotes, “‘As I live,’ says the Lord, ‘to me every knee will bow. Every tongue will confess to God.’”

questions.text: God's Kingdom is not eating and drinking, but what?
questions.explanation: Romans 14:17 says God's Kingdom is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.

answers.text: Signs, wonders, and power among the nations
Law, service, and sacrifice in the temple
Wisdom, knowledge, and speech of every kind
Righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit

questions.text: What does the text say it is good not to do?
questions.explanation: Romans 14:21 says it is good to not eat meat, drink wine, nor do anything by which your brother stumbles, is offended, or is made weak.

answers.text: Eating meat, drinking wine, or anything that makes a brother stumble
Working on a day that others esteem as more important than the rest
Speaking to those who are outside the assembly of God
Giving thanks before eating with the brothers

questions.text: Why is the one who doubts condemned if he eats?
questions.explanation: Romans 14:23 says he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it is not of faith, and whatever is not of faith is sin.

answers.text: Because he has not given thanks
